##: Xiaomi MiMo (小米 MiMo) desktop client, the China edition served from https://mimo.xiaomimimo.com/desktop/.

The landing page only links a moving alias, mimodesktop/XiaomiMiMo-latest-x64-setup.exe. The versioned file sits in the same folder as mimodesktop/XiaomiMiMo-<version>-x64-setup.exe and resolves to the same object: identical content-md5 0a3abaf72895c10e27db394ae8752391, 355576216 bytes.

The vendor publishes no version index, and the electron-updater feed named in resources/app-update.yml (provider generic, mimocode-cdn.xiaomimimo.com/mimocode/mimodesktop/) 404s on latest.yml, so checkver follows the winget-pkgs entry Xiaomi.MiMoDesktop.CN instead - the CN edition whose PackageUrl is exactly the page above. It takes the highest version folder under manifests/x/Xiaomi/MiMoDesktop/CN; the GitHub REST API is tried first and the HTML tree page is the fallback, because the unauthenticated API quota is shared per IP.

The installer is an NSIS-3 Unicode wrapper around $PLUGINSDIR\app-64.7z, which holds the Electron app flat with 'Xiaomi MiMo.exe' at the root. $R0 only carries 'Uninstall Xiaomi MiMo.exe', and $PLUGINSDIR also carries the vendor's mimo-app-processes.ps1 process guard used by its own install and upgrade path.
Only win32-x64 is published for Windows.

autoupdate.hash reads winget's InstallerSha256 from the same version folder, so a bump costs no 340 MiB download; the pinned hash equals both that value and the local SHA-256 of the 26.1113.130848 build.
description: Xiaomi MiMo desktop client for writing, slides, spreadsheets, scheduled tasks and coding (小米 MiMo 桌面客户端)
notes: The NSIS stub ($PLUGINSDIR and 'Uninstall Xiaomi MiMo.exe') is dropped, so Scoop owns the uninstall.

Sign-in state, sessions and the runtime resources the app seeds on first run live under "$env:APPDATA\Xiaomi MiMo", and the updater cache under "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\xiaomi-mimo-desktop-updater", so nothing needs to be persisted.

The bundled updater stays enabled. An in-app update runs the vendor installer, which installs a per-user copy outside the Scoop app directory instead of replacing it; run 'scoop install mimo-desktop -f' afterwards to return to the packaged build.
Because the installer is unpacked rather than executed, the xiaomi-mimo:// protocol handler the vendor registers is not created.
